observations.seen: Frames 1-3 have a low warm sun disk at the vanishing point and an orange key raking the road, matching golden hour. The player car's dark blue body stays underlit and reads as a flat silhouette against the bright road. In frame 4 (night) the car picks up an orange tint with no visible source.
No clear contact shadow grounds the player car on the asphalt. Traffic vehicles and the overhead gantries cast only faint, soft dark patches, so objects look like they float on the road.

The sun glare streak on the road is strong but has stair-stepped, blocky edges, most visible in frames 1 and 2. The car shows only a few specular glints and no readable environment reflection of sky or buildings. The night road sheen in frame 4 is a uniform blue wash.

Buildings are tall boxes with one repeating tiled window texture. Billboards are blank yellow rectangles. The highway is a straight, empty corridor with barriers and floating gold rings, and no roadside props, foliage, or skyline variety.

There is light haze around the sun disk. Distant buildings and traffic at roughly 150 m keep nearly the same contrast as near ones, so depth fog in the 30-180 m range is weak. Frame 4 adds stars but no night haze or light scattering.

The asphalt is a noisy texture smeared by blur. The car body looks like dark glossy plastic with no clearcoat or flake. Building facades are flat unlit tiles, and the trucks have simple diffuse paint.
The player car has a recognizable open-wheel shape with wing, wheels and thrusters. The trucks and van are moderately shaped. The buildings are primitive extruded boxes, and the rings are plain tori.
The symmetric vanishing-point layout with converging lane lines works. The car sits dead center at the bottom and blocks the road ahead. Rings and the HUD panel crowd the upper left.

The chase cam sits low behind the car. Buildings at the frame edges lean outward, which suggests an FOV wider than the 60° target. The car spans about 18% of frame width, inside the 15-25% target, but covers less area than that.
Heavy radial motion blur smears the whole road surface. There is bloom on the sun and a purple-orange grade with vignette. The blur and reflection pass produce blocky artifacts along the glare edge.

The score, speed gauge and AIR meter panel is clean and legible, with matching rounded pause, music and BOLTS chips. The HUD is missing in frames 3 and 4. The overhead sign text is small and low resolution.

nextChange.change: raise shadow strength toward the look target and pull the key light to an angle that throws visible contact shadows
